item.title: JavaScript Techniques for Dynamically Modifying CSS Stylesheet Rules
item.description:
“JavaScript Techniques for Dynamically Modifying CSS Stylesheet Rules”

How can developers reliably access and programmatically change styles defined within external or internal CSS stylesheets using JavaScript, considering cross-browser compatibility challenges? Manipulating stylesheets directly via the Document Object Model (DOM) is often necessary for advanced dynamic styling, but browser implementations can vary significantly. Several accepted solutions leverage the document.styleSheets collection, each presenting different trade-offs in complexity and compatibility.

Retrieving Specific CSS Rules by Selector

A primary hurdle is locating a specific rule (e.g., one targeting #header or .my-class) within the loaded stylesheets.
